tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind sheets, lists and cards. Source: playground :root background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Sheets, cards, list rows, search field.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Chips, summary pills, the 'מתוכנן' (Scheduled) tag, skeleton blocks. Source: .preview / .summary span.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover fill for rows, chips and secondary buttons. Source: button:hover.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Source control border (1.5:1 light). Decorative outlines only; inputs and outline buttons use border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Boundary of the search field, inputs and outline controls. 3.5:1 on bg, 3.8:1 on surface (light); 4.1:1+ (dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-sunken and brand-tint (11:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, headsigns, captions on surface, bg and surface-sunken (4.6:1+ light, 7:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on surface only (4.8:1 light). On bg it is 4.4:1 in light: use ink-muted there. Source: .leg-duration.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary actions, selected states, origin dot, progress. Text in brand reads on surface and bg (4.6:1+ light, 7.4:1+ dark). Source: .submit.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed primary button; brand text on brand-tint (5.6:1 light). Source: .submit:hover.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row and chip fill, active map-picker. Text on it: ink or brand-strong. Source: .map-picker[aria-pressed].

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-strong, destination and mode fills. Dark theme flips to near-black because the fills lighten (7:1+).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 3px, offset 3px. 3.2:1 on bg, 3.5:1 on surface (light); 9:1+ (dark). Source: :focus-visible.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on surface and bg (6.2:1 light, 9:1 dark). Source: a.

tokens.name: origin
tokens.usage: Origin pin, 'A' dot and the current-location puck. Always paired with the letter A or a label.

tokens.name: destination
tokens.usage: Destination pin and 'B' dot with on-brand text (4.5:1 light). As text only on surface. Source: .destination .place-dot.

tokens.name: mode-bus
tokens.usage: Bus line badges (on-brand text, 4.9:1), bus route lines on the map. Overridden by a GTFS route_color when the feed provides one. Source: map polyline.

tokens.name: mode-bus-tint
tokens.usage: Bus leg icon background. mode-bus text on it is 4.3:1 in light (source pair): use it for icons and bold 14px+ only.

tokens.name: mode-rail
tokens.usage: Rail, light rail and metro badges and map lines (on-brand text, 5.2:1). Source: map polyline.

tokens.name: mode-rail-tint
tokens.usage: Rail leg icon background; mode-rail on it is 4.5:1.

tokens.name: mode-walk
tokens.usage: Walking legs: dashed map line, walk icon and minutes. Walking is never a filled badge.

tokens.name: status-scheduled
tokens.usage: Scheduled times and the 'מתוכנן' (Scheduled) tag on surface-sunken. Every time is scheduled until the realtime wave ships.

tokens.name: status-live
tokens.usage: Intentional addition for the deferred realtime wave: realtime predictions, always with the word 'בזמן אמת' (Live) and a dot. On surface 5.4:1 light.

tokens.name: status-late
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: delay text such as '+3 min', with the word 'איחור' (late). On surface 5.5:1 light, 8:1 dark. Orange, not red, so it is not confused with cancelled.

tokens.name: status-cancelled
tokens.usage: Cancelled trips and hard errors, always with a struck time and the word 'בוטל' (Cancelled). On surface 6.6:1. Source: .status.error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmations such as 'Saved' or 'Copied'. On surface 6.3:1. Source: .status.success.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Banner fill for stale data, unavailable live times and limited coverage. Source: .notice.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icon on warning-bg (6.6:1 light, 10:1 dark). Source: .notice color.

tokens.name: warning-edge
tokens.usage: 1px outline of a warning banner. Decorative; the icon and words carry the meaning. Source: .notice border.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Banner fill for errors such as 'אין חיבור ל־OpenTransit'. status-cancelled text on it is 5.7:1.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Fill of the current navigation step (NavStep hero): maximum contrast with the page in both themes, readable in sunlight.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on hero (13:1 both themes). The focus ring on hero uses on-hero, not focus.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on hero: stop names, 'then' lines (7.3:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: hero-accent
tokens.usage: The countdown figure and 'עכשיו' label on hero (8:1 light, 5.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the map behind a fully expanded sheet.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Map placeholder and base land colour before tiles load. Source: #map background.

tokens.name: map-road
tokens.usage: Roads in mock maps and the custom MapLibre style.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea and water in the custom map style.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans Hebrew", "Arial Hebrew", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One figure per screen: a journey duration or a countdown. Tabular numerals; the slight negative tracking is for digits only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the current step's instruction. No negative tracking on Hebrew.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: הליכה 350 מ׳ לתחנה ארלוזורוב / אבן גבירול
styles.usage: Default text and every input (16px stops iOS zoom). Hebrew needs the extra line height for niqqud-free legibility at small sizes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Subtitles, headsigns, operators, stop names under a step.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Short labels above a card or step. Replaces the old all-caps eyebrow: Hebrew has no capitals.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and attribution. Nothing is smaller.

styles.name: line-number
styles.usage: Inside line badges. Tabular numerals, wrapped in <bdi>.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges; stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, badges in a leg strip, icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter (left and right), card padding. Source: mobile padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet top padding below the grabber.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before an empty state; above the safe-area bottom.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Line badges, summary pills. Source: .summary span.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, leg icons. Source: button, input.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and banners. Source: .planner, .results.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search field, chips, status tags, segmented control.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area of anything tappable (WCAG 2.5.5 / client-design).

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Search field, primary button, sheet-level actions.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Place, stop and departure rows.

tokens.name: badge-height
tokens.usage: Line badges.

tokens.name: sheet-peek
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet's resting snap point over the map; half at 55%, full at 92%.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Controls floating over the map: search field, locate button, map key. Source: .map-hint.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet edge over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg; selected cards add a brand outline instead of a deeper shadow.
